title: Solved a problem that I didn't even know I had.
text:
Solved a problem that I didn't even know I had.. [[VIDEOID:cc5b349ef8630b2ea70ecab0635ab79b]] When I first came across this product, I didn't know why it needed to exist. That is until I thought back to the times when I needed to use the Kitchenaid mixer. When I moved it, it made a horrible squeaking noise as it dragged across the counter.

The KLEVERISE Appliance Slider solves a problem I didn't realize needed to be solved even as I put up with the problems of moving my mixer every time I baked. This tray normally rests on two plastic wheels in the back and two rubber, padded feet in the front for grip. The front mechanism works by using a levering action to push down two wheels that lifts up the rubber feet and allows the appliance to move freely.

At first, the mechanism was a little bit awkward, but as you can see in my video, moving the mixer is now a one-handed affair.

Three complaints about this product. The black color isn't stands out on my counter. I thought black went with everything but somehow this really does stand out.

The second issue is that the lifting mechanism doesn't clip back into place very well when it is stowed, it just kinda flaps loose.

My last problem is the actual lifting mechanism, it's a bit awkward and you need to push down pretty hard in order to lift the mixer. I'm able to use it well enough but it could be difficult for some people.
